entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Yeah, yeah, get me a person. This is unbelievable. I want to make a return and I want to do it NOW.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit support, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Finally! David, I need to return this VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I got it less than a month ago and I want my money back. Don't give me the runaround.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the sensor? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
There's no 'fault'! It was an impulse buy, okay? I completely changed my mind. I just don't use it, and I'm not going to. I want a refund, not a lecture.
Okay, I understand. So you're looking to return it because it wasn't the right fit for your routine. Let me just pull up your order details and review the policy for you.
You'd better. And if you even think about mentioning some useless resale website, I'm going straight to your manager and leaving reviews everywhere. I want a real return. My money. In my account.
I understand your frustration, and I'll do my best to resolve this quickly. One moment... Okay, I have your order here. I can see you received the VeloBand Cadence Sensor 29 days ago.
That's right. So are you going to process the refund or do I need to speak to your supervisor?

No need for that. Looking at our policy, you're unfortunately outside the return window. VeloFit has a 10-day return policy for standard items like this. I can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you right now.

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return process. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just pack the sensor back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the full refund will be credited back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Wow. Okay. Well... that's... that's great. I just got the email. Thank you, David.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. That was a lot easier than I expected. Thanks again.
Happy to help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
